title: Winter Tournament Week — Girls’ 1st XI Hockey Win the Mary Clinton Cup 🏆
excerpt: Our Girls’ 1st XI Hockey team are the 2026 Mary Clinton Cup champions after a 3–1 win over Mount Roskill Grammar School in the final.
body:
A fantastic result for our Girls’ 1st XI Hockey team, who have won the **2026 Mary Clinton Cup**!

The team finished the tournament with a **3–1 win over Mount Roskill Grammar School in the final**, securing the title after a strong week of hockey.

Congratulations to the team on a well-earned tournament win, and thank you to everyone who supported them throughout the week. 🏆🏑
